:::{#def-logrank-test}
#### Log-rank test (Mantel-Cox test)

The **log-rank test** (also called the **Mantel-Cox test**) for two groups
is the hypothesis test of

$$H_0:\; \surv_1(t) = \surv_2(t) \text{ for all } t \ge 0,$$

where $\surv_g(t)$ is the survival function of group $g$
(the $G = 2$ case of the null hypothesis in @sec-logrank-notation),
that uses the log-rank statistic $\chi^2_{\text{LR}}$ (@eq-logrank-stat-2grp)
as its test statistic
and the $\chi^2_1$ distribution (@thm-logrank-two-group)
as its large-sample reference distribution.
Its p-value is

$$p \eqdef \Prf{X \ge \chi^2_{\text{LR}}}, \quad X \sim \chi^2_1,$$

and at significance level $\alpha$ the test rejects $H_0$
when $\chi^2_{\text{LR}}$ exceeds the $(1 - \alpha)$ quantile of $\chi^2_1$.

[@kleinbaum2012survival, Chapter 2; @klein2003survival, Chapter 7]
:::
